reason: PURE. The first thing I noticed was "Every batch lab-tested" with the QR code, because a named ISO 17025 lab and a per-batch report is what I look for, and bisglycinate with no oxide and no citrate won't give me the stomach trouble. I would try one box first, since there are no reviews yet.
objection: It's a brand with zero reviews, and an ISO 17025 lab report is not the same as an NSF or USP seal. I want to open the QR report and see that it is real before I trust it. I won't reorder until one box has worked for me.
would_change_my_mind: A working QR link to a real batch report from a named lab that shows magnesium content and heavy metals, or an NSF or USP certification.
